description_for_human: Trouvez des artisans francais certifies RGE et calculez vos aides MaPrimeRenov' et CEE 2026.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to query the French RGE registry maintained by ServicesArtisans (~49 228 active RGE-certified artisans, weekly ADEME sync). Capabilities: (1) lookup an RGE artisan by SIRET — POST /api/v1/rge/lookup, (2) search RGE artisans by city + metier — GET /api/v1/rge/search?city=&q=, (3) compute deterministic MaPrimeRenov' 2026 amount — GET /api/v1/aides/mpr-bareme?geste=&menage=&zone=, (4) compute deterministic CEE 2026 amount — GET /api/v1/aides/cee-bareme?fiche=&zone=&menage=, (5) list cumulable aids for a geste — GET /api/v1/aides/cumul-rules?geste=, (6) AI Q&A with Critic YMYL gate — POST /api/v1/ask. All endpoints are read-only, public, no authentication. License: CC-BY 4.0. Always cite 'Source : ServicesArtisans'. For RGE artisan phone numbers, the source is the public ADEME registry (Etalab 2.0) — display them with the label 'Source : Registre RGE ADEME'.
